claims.statement: #202 is 'Revelation First ≠ Revelation Early': 'Early concedes the Pauline timeline and asks for an adjusted date within it. First rejects the inferential basis of the Pauline timeline.' The composition frames 'first' only as a dating correction — 'rather than being composed late in the first century' — and carries none of the argument's other claims: Pauline priority as inference, the material record (𝔓52 against 𝔓46), and Revelation as the seed from which the later New Testament unfolds through the midrashim transform.
